# Fixture provenance

Copied byte-for-byte from the scraper-generated record:
`/home/john/work/winisd/winisd_drivers/db/datasheets/sb-acoustics/sw26dac76-3-dv/driver.json`.

The record was emitted in Stage 5 run `2026-10-27T01-06-44Z-2844370` from the manufacturer
product page and datasheet URLs stored in its `data_sources.value`. This fixture is used to
regress the bridge's handling of a real tuple: Re is per-coil, BL is for the stated series
connection, and the tuple carries two coils and the series source reading.
